blocks.value: Many beginners believe that adding more indicators makes trading easier. In reality, too many indicators often create confusion instead of clarity.

Imagine This: You're driving a car while ten different people give you directions at the same time. Instead of helping, they confuse you. Using too many indicators on a chart can feel exactly the same.
Each indicator has a different purpose. Moving Averages help identify trends, RSI measures momentum, MACD confirms momentum changes, and VWAP helps intraday traders understand average price.
A beginner might start with just one Moving Average and RSI instead of adding ten different indicators.
⚠️ No indicator can predict the future with certainty. Indicators are tools that support decision-making, not replacements for good judgment.
The best traders often use fewer indicators but understand them deeply.
You have now completed the fundamentals of Technical Analysis. In the next lessons, you'll learn additional indicators and how to combine them effectively.

blocks.question: Should beginners use many indicators together?
choices: No, it's usually better to master a few indicators first.
Yes, more indicators always improve accuracy.
